newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat up in tight trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat up in tight trade.

text.p: Argentine wheat prices rose in tight cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, as exporters bought to replace damaged grain, traders said

Exporters have recently received deliveries of grain damaged in storms in early December and is now fit only for forrage. Wheat rose $5 to $135 in Bahia Blanca, prices paid to farmers. With market attention on wheat, values for maize, soybeans and sunflower seed were unchanged. The weather is coming along nicely for all three crops, with rain across crop zones clearing up. March sunflower seed was at $205, May soybeans at $238 and April maize at $92.
